style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Pine & Berry Swag Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Add a festive touch to your home with this charming 67cm pine & berry swag. Expertly crafted to capture the natural beauty of pine foliage, it features lush green branches accented with vibrant red berries, creating a classic holiday look that instantly brightens any space. Perfect for adorning doors, windows, mantels, or tabletops, this versatile swag brings a cheerful, seasonal atmosphere to your décor. Its full, textured design gives it a realistic appearance, while its flexible shape allows for effortless styling to suit your home. Measuring 67cm in length, this faux pine and berry swag stays vibrant and beautiful year after year, with no shedding or upkeep required. Whether displayed on its own or paired with lights and ribbons, it’s an easy way to bring festive charm and lasting elegance to your home. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. . Swag Dims: L67xW30cm.
